package sample

import "github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/database/codec"

//foundry:model table=lookup var=Lookup key=ID identity=false
type LookupRecord struct {
	ID int64 `foundry:"member=ID,key-role=lookup,codec=idCodec"`
}

func idCodec() codec.Codec[int64] { return codec.Signed[int64]() }

//foundry:model table=primary_records var=PrimaryRecords key=ID identity=false
type PrimaryRecord struct {
	ID int64 `foundry:"member=ID,key-role=primary"`
}

//foundry:model table=number_records var=NumberRecords key=ID identity=false
type NumberRecord struct {
	ID int64 `foundry:"member=ID"`
}

//foundry:model table=text_records var=TextRecords key=ID identity=false
type TextRecord struct {
	ID string `foundry:"member=ID"`
}

//foundry:model table=number_primary var=NumberPrimary key=ID identity=false
type NumberPrimaryRecord struct {
	ID int64 `foundry:"member=ID,key-role=primary-number"`
}

//foundry:model table=text_primary var=TextPrimary key=ID identity=false
type TextPrimaryRecord struct {
	ID string `foundry:"member=ID,key-role=primary-text"`
}

//foundry:model table=input_records var=InputRecords key=ID identity=false
type InputRecord struct {
	ID int64 `foundry:"member=ID,key-role=input,input=int"`
}

func (InputRecord) MutateID(v int) (int64, error) { return int64(v), nil }

//foundry:model table=api_keys var=APIKeys key=ID
type APIKey struct {
 ID int64
 Key string `foundry:"member=KeyName"`
 Query string `foundry:"member=QueryValue"`
}
